name: 电动长颈鹿
evolution: 电动长颈鹿 → 奔乐鹿 Lv.28 → 爵士鹿 Lv.40 → 波普鹿
evolutionEn: Diandongchangjinglu → Benlelu Lv.28 → Jueshilu Lv.40 → Bopulu
description: 平时几乎不带电，通过尾巴放电，贸然摸尾巴可能会被电晕。听到节拍时，它体表的细微电感会跟着节奏一跳一跳，像在悄悄打拍子。
descriptionEn: Usually carries almost no electricity, discharging through its tail; touching the tail rashly may get you electrocuted. When it hears a beat, the tiny electric currents on its body jump along with the rhythm, as if quietly keeping time.

skills.name: 导电撞击
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 过载回路
skills.description: 回合结束自己返场，下回合所选技能使用次数+1。
skills.descriptionEn: At end of turn retreats self, next turn the selected skill's uses +1.

skills.name: 离子火花
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Damage reduction 70%, responding to an attack.

skills.name: 电弧
skills.description: 造成物伤，迸发：本次技能威力+40。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; outbreak: this skill's power +40.

skills.name: 闪击折返
skills.description: 造成物伤，2连击，自己脱离。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 2 hits, retreats self.

skills.name: 连续爪击
skills.description: 造成物伤，2连击，应对状态：本次技能连击数翻倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 2 hits; when responding to a status: this skill's hits doubled.

skills.name: 强制重启
skills.description: 造成魔伤，应对状态：回合结束时使敌方精灵返场。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; when responding to a status: at end of turn forces the enemy to retreat.
